```artifact
Feature: Ventilator GUI Functionality

  Scenario: Display FiO2 as measured prior to patient inhale limb
    Given the ventilator is in a stable state
    When the user views the GUI
    Then the FiO2 value is displayed as measured prior to the patient inhale limb

  Scenario: Set PIP from 5-55 cmH2O with increments of 1 cm H2O
    Given the ventilator is in a stable state
    When the user sets PIP to 5 cmH2O
    Then the PIP value is displayed as 5 cmH2O
    When the user increments PIP by 1 cmH2O
    Then the PIP value is displayed as 6 cmH2O
    When the user sets PIP to 55 cmH2O
    Then the PIP value is displayed as 55 cmH2O
    When the user increments PIP by 1 cmH2O
    Then the PIP value is displayed as 56 cmH2O

  Scenario: Detect controller shutdown
    Given the ventilator is in a stable state
    When the controller is shut down
    Then the GUI displays a shutdown message

  Scenario: Rise time parameter in pressure controlled ventilation mode
    Given the ventilator is in a stable state
    And the user is in pressure controlled ventilation mode
    When the user sets the rise time parameter to 10%
    Then the rise time parameter is displayed as 10%
    When the user sets the rise time parameter to 20%
    Then the rise time parameter is displayed as 20%
    When the user sets the rise time parameter to 0%
    Then the rise time parameter is displayed as 0%

  Scenario: Rise parameter in pressure controlled ventilation mode
    Given the ventilator is in a stable state
    And the user is in pressure controlled ventilation mode
    When the user sets the rise parameter to 10% of breath cycle time
    Then the rise parameter is displayed as 10% of breath cycle time
    When the user sets the rise parameter to 20% of breath cycle time
    Then the rise parameter is displayed as 20% of breath cycle time
    When the user sets the rise parameter to 0% of breath cycle time
    Then the rise parameter is displayed as 0% of breath cycle time

  Scenario: Assist/control with pressure controlled ventilation mode
    Given the ventilator is in a stable state
    And the user is in pressure controlled ventilation mode
    When the user selects assist/control with pressure controlled ventilation mode
    Then the assist/control with pressure controlled ventilation mode is displayed as selected

  Scenario Outline: Set PIP with edge values
    Given the ventilator is in a stable state
    When the user sets PIP to <value>
    Then the PIP value is displayed as <value>
    Examples:
      | value | edge |
      | 4     | boundary |
      | 5     | positive |
      | 6     | positive |
      | 56    | boundary |
      | 57    | negative |

  Scenario Outline: Set rise time parameter with edge values
    Given the ventilator is in a stable state
    And the user is in pressure controlled ventilation mode
    When the user sets the rise time parameter to <value>
    Then the rise time parameter is displayed as <value>
    Examples:
      | value | edge |
      | 0     | boundary |
      | 10    | positive |
      | 20    | positive |
      | 21    | negative |

  Scenario Outline: Set rise parameter with edge values
    Given the ventilator is in a stable state
    And the user is in pressure controlled ventilation mode
    When the user sets the rise parameter to <value> of breath cycle time
    Then the rise parameter is displayed as <value> of breath cycle time
    Examples:
      | value | edge |
      | 0     | boundary |
      | 10    | positive |
      | 20    | positive |
      | 21    | negative |
```
